# dcimgui — generated

**Generated by `tools/make_imgui_bindings.py`. Do not edit — including this
file, which that script writes.**

Dear ImGui is C++; these are the C bindings over it, produced by
`ext/dear_bindings` from `ext/imgui` at the commits those submodules are pinned
to. Only the two backends gearstick uses are generated — SDL3 and
SDL_Renderer3 — rather than the nineteen the upstream script emits.

**Committed on purpose**, for the same reason `src/core/gs_tables.h` is: so that
a clone builds with a C and C++ compiler and nothing else. Generating at build
time would put Python and `ply` between every contributor and a working build,
to regenerate files that change when the ImGui pin changes and at no other time.

`.github/workflows/tables.yml` re-bakes and diffs on any change to the pins, the
generator or this directory, so the committed bindings cannot drift from what
the pinned inputs produce.

To regenerate after moving the pins:

```sh
git submodule update --init --depth 1 ext/imgui ext/dear_bindings
python3 -m pip install --user ply==3.11
python3 tools/make_imgui_bindings.py
```

The generator also emits `.json` metadata describing the API, so that other
languages can build their own bindings. It is 8.5 MB, nothing here reads it, and
the script deletes it.
